community_click.meaning: Reader needs troubleshooting or community help after first-run attempt.

product_referral.meaning: Reader is ready to browse skills, workflows, or adjacent product catalogs.

resource_recovery_click.meaning: Reader clicked a recovery path after landing on the resource hub from the legacy Jellyfish redirect.
